say:1:1360205001:0.text: After driving out the Hypofiend, you look toward the figure who came to your aid...
say:1:1360205001:0.source_cn: 驱除了不知何时潜入镇子的魔物后，你们看向了前来助阵的身影……

say:3:1360205002:1.text:
It's been a while, everyone.
This area should be clear of Hypofiends for now.
say:3:1360205002:1.source_cn: 诸位，久违了。\n这里应该暂时没有其他魔物了。

say:4:1360205003:1.text: Dunlingr! Thank you so much for helping us out!
say:4:1360205003:1.source_cn: 顿里尔大人！多亏您及时出手！

say:5:1360205004:0.text: My voice is back to normal! I was scared out of my wits when I lost control of it!
say:5:1360205004:0.source_cn: 我的声音也恢复正常了！刚刚突然就无法控制，真是吓我一大跳！

say:6:1360205005:0.text: Thanks for lending us a hand! Are you... by any chance a Celestial?
say:6:1360205005:0.source_cn: 多谢您的帮助！这位……是半神大人吧？

say:7:1360205006:3.text: Dunlingr is a venerable Celestial whom you crossed paths with previously.
say:7:1360205006:3.source_cn: 顿里尔是此前的旅途中曾经遇到过的一位极有威望的半神。

say:8:1360205007:1.text: He harbors a deep aversion to evil and commands immense power. The divine toll of his bell can banish disruptions and purify any corruption.
say:8:1360205007:1.source_cn: 他嫉恶如仇，实力强大，神圣的钟声能够禁绝异常，更能净化扭曲。

say:9:1360205008:1.text: He rarely makes direct interventions, as his bell alone is capable of handling most situations.
say:9:1360205008:1.source_cn: 他很少公开出手，凭借他的钟声，已经足以应付大部分情况。

say:10:1360205009:1.text: After a brief introduction, everyone dives straight into the matter at hand.
say:10:1360205009:1.source_cn: 彼此介绍一番后，迅速地进入了正题……

say:11:1360205010:1.text: Recently, this phenomenon has occurred in several other places as well.
say:11:1360205010:1.source_cn: 简而言之，近期，“声音扭曲”这一异常事态已在多处出现。

say:12:1360205011:0.text: Everything just sounded slightly out of tune at first, but it gradually escalated into severe distortions.
say:12:1360205011:0.source_cn: 最开始只是轻微走音，接着，走音程度变得严重，甚至连发声...

choice_prompt:13:1360205011.text: Everything just sounded slightly out of tune at first, but it gradually escalated into severe distortions.
choice_prompt:13:1360205011.source_cn: 最开始只是轻微走音，接着，走音程度变得严重，甚至连发声都开始扭曲。

say:14:1360205012:0.text: Yes, all sounds are affected. It's just that the changes in the instruments are more noticeable.
say:14:1360205012:0.source_cn: 是的，一切“声音”都在影响范围之列，只是乐器的变化最容...

say:15:1360205014:0.text: In the most affected areas, people can't even control their own voices, as every sound they make turns into maniacal laughter, growls, or other odd noises.
say:15:1360205014:0.source_cn: 最严重的地方，连人们随口发出的声音都无法自控，甚至会化...

say:17:1360205016:0.text: Exactly. Your symptoms are considered mild. In the more severe cases, the victims only recovered after repeated purifications by the acolytes.
say:17:1360205016:0.source_cn: 正是如此。汝之症状尚属轻微，然而多有深度受害者，需要修...

say:18:1360205017:1.text: I tried to track down the source of the dark magic, but unfortunately, I was always one step behind.
say:18:1360205017:1.source_cn: 吾追寻着异状报告和邪恶魔力的气息探查源头。可惜，追踪并...

say:19:1360205018:1.text: Merlin, you've had plenty of experience dealing with the Hypogeans in recent years. I'd love to hear your insights.
say:19:1360205018:1.source_cn: 梅林，近年来汝与恶魔对战经验更加丰富，可否提供少许思路？
say:19:1360205018:1.male: Merlin, you've had plenty of experience dealing with the Hypogeans in recent years. I'd love to hear your insights.
say:19:1360205018:1.female: Merlin, you've had plenty of experience dealing with the Hypogeans in recent years. I'd love to hear your insights.

say:20:1360205019:3.text: Dark magic, Hypofiends, victims who can't control their voices... Magister!
say:20:1360205019:3.source_cn: 魔力的浸染，魔物诞生，受害者无法控制声音，变成混乱的狂...
say:20:1360205019:3.male: Dark magic, Hypofiends, victims who can't control their voices... Magister!
say:20:1360205019:3.female: Dark magic, Hypofiends, victims who can't control their voices... Magister!

choice_prompt:21:1360205019.text: Dark magic, Hypofiends, victims who can't control their voices... Magister!
choice_prompt:21:1360205019.source_cn: 魔力的浸染，魔物诞生，受害者无法控制声音，变成混乱的狂笑……主人！
choice_prompt:21:1360205019.male: Dark magic, Hypofiends, victims who can't control their voices... Magister!
choice_prompt:21:1360205019.female: Dark magic, Hypofiends, victims who can't control their voices... Magister!

say:22:1360205020:1.text: All of this reminds me of Berial, that crazy Hypogean! Hammie almost forgot about him!
say:22:1360205020:1.source_cn: 漫漫差点都要忘记了，这不就是那个像小丑一样疯疯癫癫的恶...
say:22:1360205020:1.male: All of this reminds me of Berial, that crazy Hypogean! Hammie almost forgot about him!
say:22:1360205020:1.female: All of this reminds me of Berial, that crazy Hypogean! Hammie almost forgot about him!

say:23:1360205022:0.text: Berial... That name is infamous among us.
say:23:1360205022:0.source_cn: 贝利尔……这名字对吾等来说可算如雷贯耳。

say:24:1360205023:0.text: He's a corrupted being who revels in pain and madness, feeding on twisted pleasure.
say:24:1360205023:0.source_cn: 癫狂、混乱、以苦痛与疯狂为乐，又以这扭曲的乐趣为食粮的...

say:25:1360205024:1.text: If it's him, it'd be hard to figure out his motive or target. After all, he acts on a whim—whether it's a grand scheme or a petty prank, he has no problem pulling it off.
say:25:1360205024:1.source_cn: 如果是他的话，动机和目标就很难确定了，毕竟那家伙随心所...

say:26:1360205025:5.text: Just as Lorsan is lost in thought, his ears suddenly twitch. He raises his hand, signaling for everyone to quiet down.
say:26:1360205025:5.source_cn: 正在沉吟之际，洛桑的耳朵突然转了转，他抬起手，大家安静...

say:27:1360205026:0.text: He listens intently to something, and then a grim expression appears on his face.
say:27:1360205026:0.source_cn: 他专注地聆听着什么，紧接着，他露出了严肃的表情。

say:28:1360205027:0.text: Guys, I just heard something through the wind—there's fighting and corrupted magic. It should be around the <style="highlight">Snowveil Hills</style>.
say:28:1360205027:0.source_cn: 各位，风中传来了交战的声音与扭曲的气味，应该是<sty...

say:29:1360205028:1.text: Though it's far away, I can hear the forest there wailing, suffering from dark magic.
say:29:1360205028:1.source_cn: 虽然有些距离，但是那附近的森林由于令人不快的魔力而发出...

say:31:1360205029:1.text: Snowveil Hills... Could Faramor have run into some Hypogeans?!
say:31:1360205029:1.source_cn: 碎雪山郊，又在交战……难道是法拉莫尔遭遇了恶魔？！

choice_prompt:32:1360205029.text: Snowveil Hills... Could Faramor have run into some Hypogeans?!
choice_prompt:32:1360205029.source_cn: 碎雪山郊，又在交战……难道是法拉莫尔遭遇了恶魔？！

say:33:1360205030:1.text: With such severe distortion at play, the wind might lose the sounds soon!
say:33:1360205030:1.source_cn: 声音扭曲得很厉害，如果慢了，很可能会逃脱风的捕捉！

say:34:1360205032:3.text: There's no time to lose. I'm slower, so you all go ahead. I'll stay behind to purge the lingering dark magic.
say:34:1360205032:3.source_cn: 事不宜迟，吾行动速度有限，汝等先行，吾留在此处祛除魔物影响。

say:35:1360205033:1.text: Just keep me in the loop if anything changes.
say:35:1360205033:1.source_cn: 若有变化，随时告知于吾。

say:36:1360205034:0.text: Hammie and Chippy will stay here to help! Magister and Lorsan, please stay safe!
say:36:1360205034:0.source_cn: 我和漫漫也留在这里帮忙吧！主人，还有洛桑，你们要小心！

narration:38:1360206001:0.text: With Lorsan's guidance, you quickly make your way to Snowveil Hills to search for Faramor.
narration:38:1360206001:0.source_cn: 在洛桑的指引下，你们迅速前往碎雪山郊，寻找法拉莫尔的行踪！

say:41:1360207001:0.text: Following the sounds, you weave your way through the woods and soon catch sight of Faramor.
say:41:1360207001:0.source_cn: 循着声音在林间穿行，你们很快发现了法拉莫尔的身影。

say:43:1360207002:1.text: He is caught up in a battle, but he doesn't seem to be struggling. There is a surprised look on his face when he notices you.
say:43:1360207002:1.source_cn: 他的确正在战斗，但看起来并非苦战，对于你们的到来，他似...

say:46:1360207004:1.text: Eh, there isn't a Hypofiend here? Never mind, we'll help you!
say:46:1360207004:1.source_cn: 咦，不是魔物？算了，我们先来帮忙！

say:48:1360205031:1.text: We've got to move fast. From what I hear, the battle's still ongoing, but this corrupt magic gives me a bad feeling...
say:48:1360205031:1.source_cn: 嗯，必须要快点了，虽然现在听着只是在交战，但这种扭曲的...
say:48:1360205031:1.male: We've got to move fast. From what I hear, the battle's still ongoing, but this corrupt magic gives me a bad feeling...
say:48:1360205031:1.female: We've got to move fast. From what I hear, the battle's still ongoing, but this corrupt magic gives me a bad feeling...

say:49:1360205021:1.text: Yes, that guy! He cackles all the time and can't stop telling creepy jokes!
say:49:1360205021:1.source_cn: 对！就是那家伙！总是狂笑！讲一些恐怖的邪恶笑话！坏东西...
say:49:1360205021:1.male: Yes, that guy! He cackles all the time and can't stop telling creepy jokes!
say:49:1360205021:1.female: Yes, that guy! He cackles all the time and can't stop telling creepy jokes!

say:50:1360205013:0.text: Yes, it's as if some corrupt magic is slowly seeping into everything.
say:50:1360205013:0.source_cn: 是的，就像是被扭曲的魔力逐渐浸染了一般。
